summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 425/TL/2019** **Coram: Shri P. K. All other terms and conditions contained in the order dated 4.3.2020 in Petition No.425/TL/2019 shall remain unchanged.
